Privacy policy

Updated July 24, 2026

What we collect

The BMI calculator runs in your browser. Heights, weights, and results are not sent to our server. If you choose to retain recent calculations, they are stored only in your browser’s local storage and can be cleared through browser settings.

Analytics

We use Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights to understand aggregate site performance. These tools help improve reliability and do not require an account to use the calculator.

Contact

Messages submitted through our contact form may include the information you provide. Do not include sensitive health information. Contact us to request deletion of a submitted message.
